dialogues.jp:
朝食を詰め込まれた後、俺の瞳にはずっと白い
天井しか映っていない。
dialogues.en:
I've been staring at the white ceiling ever since I stuffed
myself with breakfast.
dialogues.text:
I've been staring at the white ceiling ever since I stuffed
myself with breakfast.

dialogues.jp:
頭がザーザー鳴っている。結局、昨日は一睡も
出来なかった。
dialogues.en:
My head was full with the sound of static. I couldn't sleep
at all last night.
dialogues.text:
My head was full with the sound of static. I couldn't sleep
at all last night.

dialogues.jp:
さっき面会時間の開始を告げる放送があったか
ら、そろそろ音夢のやつが来るはずだ。
dialogues.en:
They announced that the visitation time was starting, so
Nemu should be here soon.
dialogues.text:
They announced that the visitation time was starting, so
Nemu should be here soon.

dialogues.jp: コンコン――
dialogues.en: Knock, knock......
dialogues.text: Knock, knock......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、具合はど――」
dialogues.en: "How do you feel, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "How do you feel, niisan?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、顔色悪いよ？　どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "You look pale! What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "You look pale! What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp: 紙袋を持った音夢が、小走りに近づいてくる。
dialogues.en: She quickly came up to me, with a paper bag in her hand.
dialogues.text: She quickly came up to me, with a paper bag in her hand.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、昨日寝てなくてな……」
dialogues.en: "I couldn't sleep last night......"
dialogues.text: "I couldn't sleep last night......"

dialogues.jp: 俺のおでこに手を当ててくる音夢にそう答える。
dialogues.en: I answered as she put her hand on my forehead.
dialogues.text: I answered as she put her hand on my forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう……心配させないでよね」
dialogues.en: "......Don't you scare me."
dialogues.text: "......Don't you scare me."

dialogues.jp: ホッとしたように音夢が手をどける。
dialogues.en: She took her hand off of me with a relieved voice.
dialogues.text: She took her hand off of me with a relieved voice.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まさか、一晩中雑誌を読んでいたんじゃない
　でしょうね……」
dialogues.en: "You haven't been reading magazines all night, have you?"
dialogues.text: "You haven't been reading magazines all night, have you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっと考え事をしててな」
dialogues.en: "No...... Something was on my mind."
dialogues.text: "No...... Something was on my mind."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「綺麗な看護師さんに恋でもしましたか？」
dialogues.en: "Did you fall in love with a pretty nurse or something?"
dialogues.text: "Did you fall in love with a pretty nurse or something?"

dialogues.jp:
からかい感じで微笑みながら、着替えの整理を
始める。
dialogues.en: She jokingly smiled and started organizing my clothes.
dialogues.text: She jokingly smiled and started organizing my clothes.

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、音夢……」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「んっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「本校行ったら、また風紀委員でもやんのか？」
dialogues.en:
"What are you going to do when you enter the main school?
Are you going to patrol again?"
dialogues.text:
"What are you going to do when you enter the main school?
Are you going to patrol again?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ！？　あ、うん……どうだろ……」
dialogues.en: "What? Oh, umm...... I don't know......"
dialogues.text: "What? Oh, umm...... I don't know......"

dialogues.jp:
やはり、本校のことを話すと、急に落ち着きが
なくなる。
dialogues.en:
She acted weird when I brought up the conversation about the
school.
dialogues.text:
She acted weird when I brought up the conversation about the
school.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう、急にどうしたのよ。誰かに勧誘でも頼
　まれたの？」
dialogues.en:
"Why are you asking me this now? Did someone ask you to
recruit me or something?"
dialogues.text:
"Why are you asking me this now? Did someone ask you to
recruit me or something?"

dialogues.jp: そう言いながら、花瓶に手を伸ばそうとする。
dialogues.en: She spoke and tried to reach the flower vase.
dialogues.text: She spoke and tried to reach the flower vase.

dialogues.jp: 「島の外に行くって、本当か？」
dialogues.en:
"Is it true that you're going to a school outside of the
island?"
dialogues.text:
"Is it true that you're going to a school outside of the
island?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 怒鳴られた子供のように、ビクッと反応する。
dialogues.en:
She reacted with fear, as if she was a small child in
trouble.
dialogues.text:
She reacted with fear, as if she was a small child in
trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうして……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、本当なんだな」
dialogues.en: "It's true, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "It's true, isn't it?"

dialogues.jp:
笑い飛ばさない音夢に、真実であることを実感
する。
dialogues.en: Looking at Nemu without a smile, I realized it was true.
dialogues.text: Looking at Nemu without a smile, I realized it was true.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それは……その……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうして外なんだよ？　詩人か小説家なら、
　別にここでも出来るだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Why do you have to go to a different school? If you want to
become a poet or an author, you can still stay here and
study!"
dialogues.text:
"Why do you have to go to a different school? If you want to
become a poet or an author, you can still stay here and
study!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……看護師に……なりたいの……」
dialogues.en: "......I want to become a nurse......"
dialogues.text: "......I want to become a nurse......"

dialogues.jp: 俯いてぽそりと呟く。
dialogues.en: She muttered.
dialogues.text: She muttered.

dialogues.jp: 「看護師？」
dialogues.en: "A nurse?"
dialogues.text: "A nurse?"

dialogues.jp:
初耳だった。てっきり詩人か小説家だと思って
いたのに……。
dialogues.en:
This's the first time I heard this from her. I thought she
wanted to become a poet or an author.
dialogues.text:
This's the first time I heard this from her. I thought she
wanted to become a poet or an author.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、なんで、いきなり看護師なんだ？　そ
　んなこと１度も言ってなかっただろ」
dialogues.en:
"Why do you want to become a nurse, all of a sudden? You've
never said anything like that before."
dialogues.text:
"Why do you want to become a nurse, all of a sudden? You've
never said anything like that before."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「体調が悪くなった時に、看護師さんにお世話
　になって、私も病気で困っている人の力にな
　りたいなって思って……」
dialogues.en:
"When I got sick a nurse took care of me, and I wanted to
take care of sick people too......"
dialogues.text:
"When I got sick a nurse took care of me, and I wanted to
take care of sick people too......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ…それならそれで、ちゃんと話せっての」
dialogues.en: "Huh...... Why didn't you tell me that earlier?"
dialogues.text: "Huh...... Why didn't you tell me that earlier?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いきなり島の外に出るなんて聞いたら、心臓
　が止まるだろうが……まったく」
dialogues.en:
"I was surprised to hear that you're going to leave the
island......"
dialogues.text:
"I was surprised to hear that you're going to leave the
island......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい……もっと早く言おうと思った
　んだけど、兄さんが交通事故に遭って、心配
　かけたくなかったから……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry...... I was going to tell you earlier, but you
got into this accident and I didn't want to make you
worried......"
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry...... I was going to tell you earlier, but you
got into this accident and I didn't want to make you
worried......"

dialogues.jp: しゅんとしているサマが、まだまだ子供だ。
dialogues.en: She looked upset just like a child.
dialogues.text: She looked upset just like a child.

dialogues.jp: 「で、家から通えるのか？」
dialogues.en: "So, are you going to commute from home?"
dialogues.text: "So, are you going to commute from home?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ううん……寮に入る……」
dialogues.en: "No...... I'm going to stay in the dorm......"
dialogues.text: "No...... I'm going to stay in the dorm......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」
それで、余計に言い出せなかったんだな。
dialogues.en: That's why it was extremely difficult to tell me......
dialogues.text: That's why it was extremely difficult to tell me......

dialogues.jp: 「手続きとかはもう済んでるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Have you finished all the administrative paperwork?"
dialogues.text: "Have you finished all the administrative paperwork?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「入寮手続きがまだ……」
dialogues.en: "I haven't finished the procedure for the dorm yet......"
dialogues.text: "I haven't finished the procedure for the dorm yet......"

dialogues.jp: か細い声で答え、首を振る。
dialogues.en: She answered with a small voice and shook her head.
dialogues.text: She answered with a small voice and shook her head.

dialogues.jp: 「ったく、トロいな。いつなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Don't wait too late! When's the due date?"
dialogues.text: "Don't wait too late! When's the due date?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "......20th of this month."
dialogues.text: "......20th of this month."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうか。じゃあ、それまでにちゃんと準備し
　て――って、今日じゃんか！？」
dialogues.en:
"I see. Well you need to take care of it by then...... hey,
that's today!"
dialogues.text:
"I see. Well you need to take care of it by then...... hey,
that's today!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は病室にあるカレンダーの日付を確認する。
dialogues.en: I looked at today's date on the calendar.
dialogues.text: I looked at today's date on the calendar.

dialogues.jp:
やはり今日は３月２０日のついでに言うと、水
曜日だッ！
dialogues.en: Today's Wednesday, March 20th!
dialogues.text: Today's Wednesday, March 20th!

dialogues.jp:
「“うん”じゃない！　なにやってるんだ、お
　まえはっ！」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean you know? What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean you know? What are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だってもヘチマもないッ。とっとと行けッ！」
dialogues.en: "Don't make any excuses! Go and take care of it now!"
dialogues.text: "Don't make any excuses! Go and take care of it now!"

dialogues.jp:
だいたい、このままここにいて、一体どうする
つもりだったんだ？
dialogues.en: What was she trying to do by staying here?
dialogues.text: What was she trying to do by staying here?

dialogues.jp:
まあ、見舞いの後からでも充分間に合うのかも
しれないが、このままここにいても決心が鈍る
だけだ。
dialogues.en:
If she stays here any longer, she'll feel unsure about her
decision.
dialogues.text:
If she stays here any longer, she'll feel unsure about her
decision.

dialogues.jp:
「ほら、洗い物は置いていっていいから、とっ
　とと行け」
dialogues.en: "You can leave my laundry, you just go."
dialogues.text: "You can leave my laundry, you just go."

dialogues.jp: しっしっ、と手を動かす。
dialogues.en: I waved my hand at her.
dialogues.text: I waved my hand at her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう、追い出すことないじゃない」
dialogues.en: "You don't have to kick me out of here."
dialogues.text: "You don't have to kick me out of here."

dialogues.jp: ぷくっと頬を膨らませる。
dialogues.en: She made an angry face.
dialogues.text: She made an angry face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ……行ってくるね」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I'll be going, then......"
dialogues.text: "Well...... I'll be going, then......"

dialogues.jp: 鞄を持って扉に向かう音夢の背中を見送る。
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
音夢は、扉のとこで１度振り返ってこちらに微
笑むと、そっと扉を閉めた。
dialogues.en:
I saw Nemu off as she held her bag and walked toward the
door. She turned around to look at me and smiled as she
closed the door.
dialogues.text:
I saw Nemu off as she held her bag and walked toward the
door. She turned around to look at me and smiled as she
closed the door.

dialogues.jp: 鈴の音が遠ざかり、やがて聞こえなくなった。
dialogues.en:
The sound of her bell faded, and I couldn't hear her
anymore.
dialogues.text:
The sound of her bell faded, and I couldn't hear her
anymore.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢の夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu's dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu's dream◆

dialogues.jp:
見舞いにやって来てくれた音夢に、杉並から｛き／訊｝
いた事を｛たず／訊｝ねた。
dialogues.en: I asked Nemu about what I heard from Suginami.
dialogues.text: I asked Nemu about what I heard from Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
音夢は、看護師になるために、島を出て寮生活
をするらしいのだ。それならそうと、早く言っ
てもらいたかったぞ。
dialogues.en:
Nemu's going to move off the island and study to become a
nurse. She should've told me earlier......
dialogues.text:
Nemu's going to move off the island and study to become a
nurse. She should've told me earlier......
